staff_announcements.entry.description: The name of the screen of the server's announcements to every local user, in the list at /admin and as the title of its screen. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.entry.hint.defaultMessage: News for everyone on this server
staff_announcements.entry.hint.description: The line under Announcements in the list at /admin: what its screen holds. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.filters.description: For assistive technology, the name of the filters over the list of announcements at /admin/announcements. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.filter.state.description: The filter of the announcements by where they stand (a draft, scheduled, showing, ended, withdrawn). Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.filter.any.description: The choice of the state filter that keeps every announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.loading.description: At /admin/announcements while the list is read. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.failed.description: At /admin/announcements when the list could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.empty.filtered.description: At /admin/announcements when the state filter keeps none. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.window.both.description: When an announcement shows: both sides of its window, each a date and a time. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.window.from.description: When an announcement shows: from a moment, until it is withdrawn. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.window.open.defaultMessage: From its publication until it is withdrawn

staff_announcements.section.description: The heading of the section of an announcement's title. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.title.description: The field of an announcement's title, plain text on one line. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.title.rule.description: Under the title of an announcement when it is empty, too long or has a line break. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.text.placeholder.defaultMessage: What everyone on this server should know

staff_announcements.when.description: The heading of the section of when an announcement shows to the readers. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.when.about.description: Under the heading of when an announcement shows: the zone its start and end are in. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.when.invalid.defaultMessage: Enter a date and a time that exist, or leave it empty.

staff_announcements.starts.description: The field of the moment an announcement starts to show, a date and a time. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.ends.after.description: Under the end of an announcement's window when it is not after its start. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.publish.title.description: The question before publishing an announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.publish.text.defaultMessage: Everyone on this server sees it and is notified once it starts to show. Changes after that notify nobody again.
staff_announcements.publish.text.description: Under the question before publishing an announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.publish.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before publishing an announcement, keeping it as it was. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.published.description: Beside Save once an announcement was published. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.save.refused.defaultMessage: Nothing was saved. Fix what is marked and try again.
staff_announcements.save.refused.description: Beside the buttons of an announcement's form when a field was refused, which is marked under it. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.save.failed.defaultMessage: Nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.
staff_announcements.save.failed.description: Beside the buttons of an announcement's form when the save failed with no field named. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.save.withdrawn.defaultMessage: This announcement was withdrawn meanwhile, so it can no longer change. Reload the page to see it.
staff_announcements.save.withdrawn.description: Beside the buttons of an announcement's form when the server refused the change because it was withdrawn. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.standing.heading.description: The heading of the first section of an announcement's page: its state, when it shows, when it was published and revised. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.published_at.description: A fact of an announcement: when it was last published (a date and a time). Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.revised_at.description: A fact of an announcement: when its text or window last changed (a date and a time). Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.preview.description: The heading of the section of an announcement's page that shows its title and its text as readers get them. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.description: The heading of the last section of an announcement's page, apart, which withdraws it. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.about.defaultMessage: Nobody sees it again, and it can no longer change or be published. Its notifications are hidden.

staff_announcements.withdraw.press.description: The button that withdraws an announcement, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.title.description: The question before withdrawing an announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.text.defaultMessage: Nobody sees it again. This cannot be undone.
staff_announcements.withdraw.text.description: Under the question before withdrawing an announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before withdrawing an announcement, keeping it. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.withdraw.failed.defaultMessage: The announcement was not withdrawn. Check your connection and try again.
staff_announcements.withdraw.failed.description: In the section that withdraws an announcement when it failed. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.description: The heading of the section of a draft announcement's page that deletes it. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.about.defaultMessage: Nobody ever saw it. It is gone from the list, and the audit log keeps its title.
staff_announcements.delete.about.description: Under the heading of the section that deletes a draft announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.press.description: The button that deletes a draft announcement, and the confirmation of its question. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.title.description: The question before deleting a draft announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.cancel.description: The button that closes the question before deleting a draft announcement, keeping it. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.text.defaultMessage: Its title and text are gone. This cannot be undone.
staff_announcements.delete.text.description: Under the question before deleting a draft announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.failed.defaultMessage: The draft was not deleted. Check your connection and try again.
staff_announcements.delete.failed.description: In the section that deletes a draft announcement when it failed. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.delete.published.defaultMessage: It was published meanwhile, so it was not deleted. Withdraw it instead.
staff_announcements.delete.published.description: In the section that deletes a draft announcement when the server refused because someone published it meanwhile (409). Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.irreversible.description: The mark beside the button that withdraws an announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.loading_one.description: On an announcement's page while it is read. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.failed_one.defaultMessage: The announcement could not be loaded.
staff_announcements.failed_one.description: On an announcement's page when it could not be read, before Try again. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.missing.defaultMessage: There is no announcement at this address.
staff_announcements.missing.description: At /admin/announcements/{id} for an ID no announcement has, before the link to all announcements. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.all.description: The link to /admin/announcements under the sentence that an address names no announcement. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.section.about.defaultMessage: Plain text on one line, up to {max} characters.
staff_announcements.section.about.description: Under the heading of an announcement's title: its format and its limit. Read by administrators.

staff_announcements.list.all.description: The heading of the list of announcements at /admin/announcements while no state filter is applied, with Write an announcement at its end. Read by administrators.
